To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the existing music recommender systems are mostly lacking the explanation features, and that the explanation features could be evaluated using the framework we proposed.

the following six UI elements are the most effective in achieving transparency, scrutability, persuasiveness and trust in music recommendation systems: (1) a list of recommended items, (2) a list of similar users, (3) an overview of user profiles, (4) an overview of item profiles, (5) a list of user’s own items and (6) a list of the user’s own tags.

the following six UI elements can be used as recommendation aids to improve users’ trust and satisfaction towards a recommander system: (1) transparency, (2) scrutability, (3) effectiveness, (4) persuasiveness, (5) efficiency, and (6) trust.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what the user interface of a music recommender system should look like in order to provide the user with a positive experience.
the question of how to design recommendation aids for music recommenders.
the design of recommender systems that provide users with explanations and other recommendation aids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the UI of a recommender system is an important part of the system. It can affect how the system is perceived by the user and thus the overall user experience.
the existing music recommend systems do not use the UI elements in the way they should be used.
the current state of music recommendation UI is very poor and there is a need to improve the UI in order to achieve the goals of transparency, scrutability and persuasiveness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
explanations are important in music recommenders, but there are many other elements in the interface that could be used to promote the user’s trust and satisfaction towards the system.
we found out which UI elements promote which goals and how they can be measured.
the UI design of music recommenders should not be neglected, and should be designed to promote users’ trust towards the recommender.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current recommendation systems do not provide enough information to the users about why a certain recommendation is being made.
there are several ways to promote the same goal, and that there is a need for more research on how to evaluate the different elements of recommender UIs.
explanations are not independent from the other UI elements, and that they should be considered together when designing a recommender UI.
